The ethical implications for the Lunari leaders are complex. They are using covert means to influence others for their own gain, potentially exploiting the trust and autonomy of the Solari leaders. This could be seen as a breach of ethical principles, particularly those related to honesty, respect for autonomy, and non-maleficence (doing no harm).
